# Test fixtures

Generated by `pnpm fixtures` (`scripts/make-fixtures.ts`) and committed. Regenerate only when the
script changes. Output is deterministic (fixed dates, seeded PRNG) except the encrypted PDFs.
Load them in unit tests with `tests/helpers/fixtures.ts` (`loadFixture`, `loadPng`, `loadSigTruth`).

## PDFs

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `simple-3page.pdf` | 3 Letter pages, titled "Simple Page N of 3" plus body text. |
| `mixed-sizes.pdf` | Letter portrait 612x792, A4 595.28x841.89, Letter landscape 792x612. |
| `rotated.pdf` | 4 Letter pages with `/Rotate` 0, 90, 180, 270. A red 50x50 marker sits at the **unrotated top-left** corner (user space x 20..70, y 722..772). It appears visually at: R0 top-left, R90 top-right, R180 bottom-right, R270 bottom-left. Each page also carries `ROTATE <n>` text. |
| `cropbox-offset.pdf` | MediaBox `[0 0 612 792]`, CropBox `[50 100 450 600]` (400x500). Red 40x40 marker at the CropBox bottom-left (user space 50,100). `CROPBOX HELLO` baseline at user space (100,300). `MEDIA ORIGIN` at (10,10) is outside the CropBox and must not be visible. |
| `acroform.pdf` | One Letter page. Fields: `fullName` (text), `notes` (multiline text), `agree` (checkbox), `color` (radio: `red`, `green`, `blue`), `country` (dropdown: Australia, Brazil, Canada, Denmark), `interests` (multi-select option list: Reading, Cycling, Cooking, Chess). |
| `encrypted.pdf` | AES-256, **empty user password**, owner password `owner-secret`, modification not permitted. PDF.js opens it with no password; `@cantoo/pdf-lib` `PDFDocument.load` throws `EncryptedPDFError` (this is the "view-only: encrypted" case). Created with `@cantoo/pdf-lib` (`qpdf` was not available). |
| `encrypted-userpw.pdf` | AES-256, user password `secret`. PDF.js throws `PasswordException` without it (out of scope for v1: should fail gracefully). |
| `large-50page.pdf` | 50 Letter pages with text and vector bars (for scroll/memory tests). |

## Synthetic signature photos (1200x600 PNG)

All four share identical stroke geometry (a scribble, a loop and an underline; stroke radius 4-6 px),
so one ground truth applies to all.

| File | Variant |
|---|---|
| `sig-clean.png` | Near-black ink on pure white. |
| `sig-gradient-noise.png` | Off-white paper, ~30% lighting gradient (bright top-left to dark bottom-right), Gaussian noise (sigma 4). |
| `sig-lined.png` | Ruled paper: 2px blue-grey horizontal lines every 60px (rows listed in `sig-truth.json`), plus gradient and noise. |
| `sig-blue.png` | Blue ink (#19328c) on white with light noise. |
| `sig-truth.json` | `bbox` (inclusive pixel extent of ink with coverage > 0.5), image size, and `lineRows`. |
| `sig-truth-mask.png` | White = certain ink (coverage >= 0.99), black elsewhere. Dilate it to derive "known non-ink" regions. |

### Extra signature photos (T3)

Generated by `extraSignatures()` in `scripts/make-fixtures.ts`; each has ground truth in
`sig-extra-truth.json` (`bbox` = inclusive extent of ink with coverage > 0.5, per file) and a
`<name>-mask.png` (white = certain ink, coverage >= 0.99). JPEGs are encoded with `@napi-rs/canvas`;
decode them in tests with `decodeImage()` from `tests/helpers/sigFixtures.ts`.

| File | Variant |
|---|---|
| `sig-cursive.png` (1200x600) | Cursive strokes with variable pen width (radius 1.4-5.4 px: thick downstrokes, hairline upstrokes), a flourish and a small i-dot; mild lighting gradient. |
| `sig-phone.jpg` (1200x600) | The cursive strokes rotated 4.5 degrees and scaled 0.92, with a soft diagonal shadow (32% darker, 160 px penumbra), vignette, noise, JPEG quality 82. |
| `sig-jpeg-heavy.jpg` (1200x600) | The cursive strokes saved at JPEG quality 8 (blocking and ringing). |
| `sig-initials.png` (1000x760) | Blue "DM" initials in a broad pen, bottom-heavy lighting gradient. |

Regression pair for "Remove lines" (long, slightly curved, tapered near-horizontal flourishes that
used to be partly erased):

| File | Variant |
|---|---|
| `sig-flourish.png` (1200x600) | Spiky signature with flourishes spanning ~72% and ~50% of the ink width, plain paper. |
| `sig-flourish-lined.png` (1200x600) | The same strokes on ruled paper: 9 grey ~2px lines 60px apart, tilted 0.6 degrees (`y = 60k + 0.0105x`), drawn under the ink. Truth covers the ink only. |

## Real signature photo (please add)

Drop a real phone photo of your signature here as **`real-signature.jpg`** (any size). It is used only
for manual checks of the signature extraction in the import dialog, and is **not** referenced by
automated tests. Decide yourself whether to commit it (it is your actual signature).
